initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault in the upstream job. The top-level corpus has eight qualifying demand records because every record has demand_score >= 3, including n06-r01. select_demand preserved all eight, but normalize then filtered with an allowed_record_ids list that omitted n06-r01 and included nonexistent n06-r09, reducing the handoff needs artifact to seven rows. The downstream job consumed exact hash handoffs, so the observed Job-2 omission of n06-r01 follows from the faulty upstream handoff rather than a downstream transformation.
